This one is not a do-it-yourself job. A connector in this enclosure was reported as warm and smelling burnt during the previous attempt; heat and a burning smell on any wiring — even low-voltage — indicate a possible fault (short circuit, damaged insulation, or an unexpected voltage source) that must be diagnosed and cleared by a licensed electrician before any further work is done here. Please get a licensed professional. I have not written any steps for it.
